input: limit is a positive integer<=1000000, goal is an integer with abs(goal)<=1000000000, and nums has at most100000 integers with abs(value)<=limit. Added integers must also have absolute value<=limit. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Minimum number of added elements needed to make the total equal goal.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Absolute total/gap are at most101000000000, safely exact. Remainder is computed first; quotient=(gap-remainder)/limit is an exact integer, avoiding an unguarded ceiling of a rounded ratio or gap+limit-1 overflow. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n+1) time/O(1) auxiliary space. Each added element can close at most limit of the absolute gap, and full-size additions plus one remainder attain the bound. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 262 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.
evidence_boundary: Authored permitted dev_fit alternative outside frozen source sets. Membership checked only against already-public cost-decomposition-v1/contract.json partition.dev_fit and candidate manifest. Input/effect/complexity declarations are not frozen-predecessor equivalence receipts. No candidate execution/import, behavioral qualification, benchmark acceptance or M1/M2 pass is claimed. Mandatory isolated judging remains blocked; private original source/case/receipt material is unavailable. Static syntax/metadata checks do not establish correctness. Independent source-bound isolated qualification must cover empty, already at goal, positive/negative gap, exact multiple, remainder1, cancellation and maximal standard bounds, actual return types, numerical/Unicode and effect contracts, full source/adapter charges and complexity before admission or promotion.
